# v2.94-dev

A small housekeeping release with no effect on a running system.

## Changed

- **The development server no longer edits `CLAUDE.md` on startup.** Next.js
  16.3 added a feature that writes a block of its own text into that file every
  time `npm run dev` starts. It reached this project as a side effect of the
  dependency upgrade in v2.87, and it only ever ran in development — production
  servers build and start the app, so they were never affected.

  The result was that `CLAUDE.md` showed up as changed in Git for no reason
  anyone had caused, which is an easy thing to "tidy up" with a command that
  also throws away genuine edits sitting alongside it. The feature is now turned
  off via its documented setting, so the file only changes when someone changes
  it.

## Upgrading

No database changes and no configuration. Nothing to do — if you never run the
app in development mode, nothing was affecting you in the first place.
